title: LLM-Based Schema-Aware Split Learning for Privacy-Preserving Mental Distress Prediction Across Heterogeneous Surveys
abstract: arXiv:2609.15871v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rising societal and lifestyle complexity has been linked to a growing prevalence of mental distress worldwide. Educational institutions, workplaces, clinics, etc. collect large volumes of mental health survey data to understand and reduce this burden. Collaborative analysis of such data could yield effective generalizable predictive models. Privacy constraints and varied survey designs (i.e., different questions, scales, and formats) hinder direct integration. We propose a schema-aware split learning (SL) framework that preserves privacy, using a large language model (LLM) as a shared semantic encoder to harmonize heterogeneous survey schemas across institutions. We serialize each survey record into a natural-language description, unifying disparate survey schemas into a common format. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的模式感知分割学习：实现跨异构调查的隐私保护心理困扰预测
translated_abstract: 社会与生活方式复杂性的不断上升与世界范围内心理困扰患病率的增长密切相关。教育机构、工作场所、诊所等收集了大量心理健康调查数据，以理解和减轻这一负担。对这些数据进行协同分析可以获得有效且具有泛化能力的预测模型。然而，隐私限制以及各异的调查设计（即不同的问题、量表和格式）阻碍了数据的直接整合。我们提出了一种保护隐私的模式感知分割学习框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）作为共享的语义编码器，来协调各机构之间异构的调查模式。我们将每条调查记录序列化为自然语言描述，从而将不同的调查模式统一为通用格式。通过低秩适应（LoRA）对LLM进行心理困扰评估的微调，并将其分割部署在客户端与服务器之间。客户端保留原始调查记录（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了一种基于大语言模型的模式感知分割学习框架，通过将异构的调查记录序列化为自然语言，并以LoRA微调的LLM作为共享语义编码器，在保护隐私的前提下实现了跨机构异构心理健康调查数据的协同心理困扰预测。
en_tdlr: Proposes a schema-aware split learning framework that serializes heterogeneous survey records into natural language and uses a LoRA fine-tuned LLM as a shared semantic encoder, enabling privacy-preserving mental distress prediction across institutions.
